name: rtmp-file-streamer
description: Local file to RTMP live streaming desktop app powered by FFmpeg
author: TurboKre
//engines: The toolchain CI installs and the one used locally. CI pins the same versions explicitly (see .github/workflows) so the compiler and its lib types cannot drift between a runner and a local run.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.dist: node scripts/build-info.mjs && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win --x64 --dir --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.test:ci: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:e2e

//esbuild: Direct, not just transitive (vite and electron-vite each pull one in): the test entry points bundle the modules under test with this exact package, so it is declared here and not left to resolution. CI proved that matters — with esbuild only transitive, its platform binary (@esbuild/<platform>-<arch>, an optionalDependency) was never installed on Linux and the whole non-Electron suite died at the bundling step.
